title: Feature request: view history of claude output from all sessions
body: Feature Request - Add a way to view all the history of all things asked and what claude outputted in response for any project that claude was asked to perform tasks/questions over. This would be stored locally and is just a stream of data, request / response  streams.
author: valdezm

top_comments.author: 4ydx
top_comments.body:
I asked claude to make something for me and this is what it produced:

```
#!/bin/bash

# Create history directory based on current working directory
CURR_DIR=$(pwd | sed 's/\//_/g' | sed 's/\./_/g' | sed 's/^_home_//')
HISTORY_DIR="$HOME/.config/claude/history/$CURR_DIR"
mkdir -p "$HISTORY_DIR"

# Create timestamp for the current session
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
LOG_FILE="$HISTORY_DIR/$TIMESTAMP.txt"

# Start claude and tee output to the log file
claude "$@" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
`

top_comments.author: peterkaminski
top_comments.body: @valdezm, I know it's not the whole thing, but your inputs at least are saved in `~/.claude.json` (Mac). Look for the JSON key`"history"`.

top_comments.author: greggh
top_comments.body: I use prompts to accomplish something like this. it's not exact and of course not perfect. But it keeps a history, uses it for context and archives old entries when it gets to long. I have a prompt I run at the start of a session (new or after /compact), and one that I run at the end of a session before a /compact or exiting.
